title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 14 subsidiaries win CNY 1.447bn of State Grid procurement (transformers, switchgear, UHV equipment)
snippet: China XD Electric (中国西电) announced that 14 of its subsidiaries jointly won State Grid (国家电网) procurement tenders totaling CNY 1.447bn. The award covers power-grid equipment including transformers and switchgear, underscoring continued State Grid purchasing of high-voltage apparatus from domestic manufacturers.
src: Sina Finance 新浪财经 · 30 Dec 2025 [zh]

title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 6 subsidiaries win CNY 1.899bn of State Grid UHV project procurement
snippet: China XD Electric said six of its subsidiaries won State Grid procurement worth CNY 1.899bn for UHV (特高压) projects. The award extends the company's streak of large grid-equipment orders, consistent with accelerating State Grid UHV and AC/DC transmission construction.
src: Dahe Cube 大河财立方 · 12 Jun 2026 [zh]

title: 平高电气 Pinggao Electric: wins CNY 876m of State Grid procurement (GIS/switchgear)
snippet: Pinggao Electric (平高电气) announced it won State Grid procurement tenders worth about CNY 876m. The listed switchgear maker's award reflects sustained State Grid spending on HV switchgear and related substation equipment.

title: 许继电气 XJ Electric: wins about CNY 1.245bn of State Grid UHV projects
snippet: XJ Electric (许继电气) disclosed it won State Grid UHV-related procurement totaling about CNY 1.245bn. The order book adds HVDC/UHV control-protection and converter-related equipment work for the State Grid network, per its voluntary disclosure announcement.
src: East Money 东方财富 · 23 Jul 2026 [zh]

title: 保变电气 Baoding Tianwei Baobian Electric wins 500kV main transformer supply for Hebei Lingshou pumped-storage station
snippet: Baobian Electric (保变电气) won the procurement of 500kV three-phase two-winding oil-immersed water-cooled power transformers for the Hebei Lingshou pumped-storage hydropower station. The order highlights demand for large power transformers in pumped-storage and grid-ancillary projects.

title: 特变电工 TBEA: bid-evaluation result for main transformers of Jinsha River upper-reach Changbo hydropower station
snippet: TBEA (特变电工) appeared in the bid-evaluation announcement for the main power transformers and auxiliary equipment of the Changbo hydropower station on the upper Jinsha River (Huadian's project). The result is a sign of large-hydro main-transformer supply going to domestic manufacturers.

title: Shanbei–Anhui ±800 kV UHVDC transmission project completed and commissioned
snippet: Xinhua reported that the Shanbei–Anhui (陕北—安徽) ±800kV ultra-high-voltage DC transmission project entered commercial operation. The line transmits northwest power to the Anhui load center, expanding the UHVDC corridor network that drives demand for converter transformers and converter-valve equipment.

title: State Grid: grid construction accelerated across all voltage levels in H1 2026
snippet: State Grid Corporation (国家电网) said grid construction at all voltage levels was accelerated in the first half of 2026. The official update signals continued heavy investment in substations, transmission lines and distribution networks — the demand backdrop for transformer, switchgear and UHV equipment makers.
src: State Grid 国家电网官网 · 21 Jul 2026 [zh]

title: German grid operators say transformers are becoming a bottleneck for grid expansion
snippet: ZfK reports that key grid components, notably transformers, are turning into a bottleneck for German grid expansion, with utilities (Stadtwerke) and distribution network operators facing long procurement lead times as reinforcement work accelerates. The article highlights how transformer supply constraints are shaping network planning and purchasing decisions.

title: Billion-euro order for an offshore wind grid-connection platform in Germany
snippet: Energynewsmagazine reports a billion-euro order for a wind-power platform in Germany, part of the country's offshore grid connection build-out. The contract underscores the scale of investment in offshore converter infrastructure needed to connect North Sea wind farms to the onshore grid.

title: Mitnetz Strom earmarks EUR 531 million for grid expansion, digitalisation and resilience in 2026
snippet: German distribution system operator Mitnetz Strom announced investments of EUR 531 million for 2026, earmarked for grid expansion, digitalisation and resilience measures. The programme reflects continued reinforcement of the German distribution network as renewable capacity and electrification grow.

title: RTE transports a transformer for the future 'Les Îles' substation by exceptional convoy
snippet: RTE carried out an exceptional heavy-transport operation to deliver a transformer for the future 'Les Îles' substation. The delivery illustrates the logistics involved in installing large power transformers as the French transmission grid is reinforced with new substations.

title: French regulator CRE approves RTE's EUR 4.24 billion investment programme for 2026
snippet: France's energy regulator CRE approved RTE's 2026 investment programme of EUR 4.24 billion, consistent with the trajectory set in the TURPE 7 transmission network tariff decision. The approval backs sustained spending on the French transmission grid, including substations and network reinforcement.

title: RHODÉ consortium launches major R&D project for floating HVDC connection of deep-water offshore wind
snippet: RTE and its partners launched the RHODÉ consortium, a major R&D project developing floating HVDC electrical connection technology for offshore wind farms in deep waters. The initiative targets grid-connection solutions for wind parks located beyond the reach of conventional bottom-fixed converter platforms.

title: TCN expands Lagos power grid with 840MVA transformer roll-out
snippet: Nigeria's Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN) is rolling out 840MVA of transformer capacity across Lagos substations, boosting transmission capacity in the country's commercial capital. The programme is part of ongoing reinforcement of the Lagos transmission network.

title: KETRACO energises Isinya–Konza 400kV line, boosting grid reliability for Konza Technopolis
snippet: Kenya's KETRACO energised the Isinya–Konza 400kV transmission line, strengthening grid reliability and power supply to Konza Technopolis. The line adds high-voltage transmission capacity for the technopolis and the wider Lower Eastern region of Kenya.

title: GE Vernova posts $7.1 billion in electrification orders
snippet: GE Vernova reported $7.1 billion in electrification orders, reflecting sustained demand for grid equipment as utilities invest in transmission infrastructure. The result highlights the continuing global upswing in grid, transformer and related electrical-equipment spending.

title: Hitachi Energy adds USD 150m to expand power transformer manufacturing capacity in Latin America
snippet: Hitachi Energy announced an additional USD 150 million investment to expand its power transformer manufacturing capacity in Latin America, reaffirming its commitment to the region. The move targets growing demand for large power transformers amid grid expansion and renewable integration across Latin American markets.

title: Chile's Coordinador Eléctrico proposes 45 transmission expansion projects worth over USD 700m
snippet: Chile's Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional proposed 45 transmission expansion projects with an estimated investment of more than USD 700 million, part of the 2026 transmission planning cycle. The package includes new lines and substation works aimed at reinforcing the national transmission grid.

title: Red Eléctrica expands Magallón substation in Zaragoza province to reinforce Spain's transmission grid
snippet: Red Eléctrica de España is expanding the Magallón substation in Zaragoza province as part of efforts to boost industrial development and reinforce the transmission (transport) grid in the area. The project strengthens supply capacity for the surrounding region in northeastern Spain.

title: CFE strengthens northwestern Mexico's grid with new substation and transmission infrastructure
snippet: Mexico's state utility CFE is reinforcing the electrical network of the northwest with new infrastructure, including substation and transmission works. The effort is aimed at improving supply reliability in the region served by CFE's northwestern divisions.

title: Dominican Republic's EDEESTE puts new power transformer into operation at Los Minas 138 kV substation
snippet: Dominican Republic distribution utility EDEESTE commissioned a new power transformer at its Los Minas 138 kV substation. The unit is part of the distributor's program to reinforce transformation capacity and improve supply reliability in its service area.

title: Ecuador's CELEC installs new transformer raising Esmeraldas electrical capacity by 61%
snippet: Ecuador's state power company CELEC (Hidronación) installed a new transformer that increases the electrical capacity of the province of Esmeraldas by 61%. The upgrade strengthens transformation capacity in the coastal region.

title: Peru's MINEM optimizes transmission projects to reinforce national grid security and reliability
snippet: Peru's Ministry of Energy and Mines (MINEM) announced it is optimizing electrical transmission projects as part of efforts to reinforce the security and reliability of the national electricity system. The measures touch on the planning of transmission lines and related grid infrastructure.

title: Colombia's ANLA approves second environmental license modification for 500 kV La Loma–Sogamoso transmission line
snippet: Colombia's National Environmental Licensing Authority (ANLA) approved the second modification of the environmental license for the La Loma–Sogamoso 500 kV transmission line. The 500 kV project is part of Colombia's high-voltage transmission expansion to integrate generation and reinforce the national grid.

title: Terna and STEG award €770m Elmed converter-station contract to Hitachi Energy
snippet: Terna and Tunisian TSO STEG awarded Hitachi Energy the €770 million tender for the converter stations of the Elmed interconnection between Italy and Tunisia, billed as the first power link between Europe and Africa. The scope covers the HVDC converter stations, the grid-equipment core of the project, including converter transformers and power-electronics systems. The award confirms Hitachi Energy as lead supplier for the two terminal stations.

title: Tyrrhenian Link: Terna completes last of three exceptional transformer transports to Termini Imerese converter station
snippet: Terna completed the last of three exceptional (maxi) road transports of large transformers to the Termini Imerese conversion station for the Tyrrhenian Link HVDC project, which will connect Sicily, Sardinia and Campania. The oversized transformer loads had to be moved on special convoys, marking a logistics milestone for the converter-station build-out. The station is a key node of the 500 kV-class HVDC link under construction.

title: Slovenian TSO ELES and Terna sign agreement to upgrade Slovenia–Italy cross-border connection (€250m, +600 MW)
snippet: ELES and Terna signed an agreement to upgrade the electricity interconnection between Slovenia and Italy along the Divača–Sredipolje–Padriče corridor, with coverage reporting an investment of about €250 million and roughly 600 MW of additional transfer capacity. The upgrade is aimed at grid resilience and more stable operation of both transmission systems. It represents a cross-border grid-reinforcement program in which Terna acts as co-investor with a neighbouring TSO.

title: CPFL Paulista invests over R8m to expand and modernize Piracicaba 2 substation
snippet: CPFL Paulista invested more than R8 million in the expansion and modernization of the Piracicaba 2 substation in São Paulo state, increasing the energy capacity available to the region. Substation works of this type typically include replacement or addition of power transformers, bays and protection equipment. The project is part of CPFL's distribution-grid reinforcement program in the interior of São Paulo.

title: Terna: €1.5bn of grid investments in H1 2026 (+19.8%), with a record second quarter (+41.3%)
snippet: Terna reported €1.5 billion of investments in the first half of 2026, up 19.8% year-on-year, with the second quarter setting a record (+41.3%), according to its interim results. The capex is largely directed at developing and reinforcing the national transmission grid, including new lines, stations and HVDC links. The figure confirms acceleration of Terna's multi-year investment plan on electricity infrastructure.

title: Terna starts authorization process for €80m grid interventions in Milan province
snippet: Terna launched the authorization process for interventions on the electricity transmission network in the province of Milan, with an investment of about €80 million. The works target the renewal and reinforcement of the transmission network serving the metropolitan area. The announcement is part of Terna's ongoing program to upgrade high-voltage infrastructure around major Italian cities.

title: Terna launches authorization process for a new electrical substation in Pisa province
snippet: Terna started the authorization process for building a new electrical substation in the province of Pisa, a project aimed at strengthening the regional transmission grid. The new station is intended to improve network resilience and support the connection of new generation in the area. The authorization route involves the Italian Ministry of the Environment and Energy Security (MASE).

title: Terna brings new eastern Sicily connection into service, completing the Paternò–Pantano–Priolo line
snippet: Terna made operational a new connection that strengthens the electricity grid of eastern Sicily, with Quotidiano Energia reporting completion of the new Paternò–Pantano–Priolo line. The infrastructure increases redundancy and supply security for the area. The commissioning is part of Terna's regional transmission investments in Sicily.

title: Toshiba Energy Systems wins HVDC order to renew Pole 1 of J-Power Transmission Network's Hokkaido–Honshu link
snippet: Toshiba Energy Systems & Solutions (東芝エネルギーシステムズ) received an order from J-Power group's 電源開発送変電ネットワーク for the renewal of Pole 1 of the Hokkaido–Honshu interconnection, covering design, procurement and installation of self-commutated AC/DC converter equipment comprising converters, transformers and control/protection devices. The ~167 km HVDC link (600 MW total, 300 MW per pole) between Hakodate and Kamikita converter stations has operated since 1979. Equipment delivery starts from FY2029, with operation planned during FY2031.
src: 東芝エネルギーシステムズ ニュースリリース · 16 Mar 2026 [ja]

title: Toshiba Energy Systems to invest ~JPY 55bn in transmission/distribution equipment output; Hamakawasaki and India capacity to double by FY2030
snippet: Toshiba Energy Systems & Solutions announced ~JPY 55bn of production investment in its transmission/distribution equipment business through FY2027 — about JPY 35bn on top of the ~JPY 20bn announced in July 2024 — targeting its Hamakawasaki Works (Kawasaki) and Indian subsidiary TTDI. Production capacity at both sites is to more than double by FY2030 versus FY2024. The expansion covers transformers, switchgear and arresters, citing grid renewal, renewables expansion and data-center demand.
src: 東芝エネルギーシステムズ ニュースリリース · 17 Oct 2025 [ja]

title: Hitachi Energy announces record ~JPY 48bn China investment to expand transformer capacity at Hefei subsidiary
snippet: Hitachi Energy (日立エナジー) announced on 17 Aug 2026 a strategic investment of about USD 300 million (~JPY 48bn) in China — described as its largest single investment in the country — at its Hefei transformer subsidiary, marked by completion of a digital tap-changer production line and groundbreaking of an ultra-high-voltage bushing project. The investment extends its power transformer business and component manufacturing to strengthen its global supply network amid surging transformer demand.

title: Daido Japan wins distribution transformer orders at JECA FAIR 2026 with 2026 Top Runner-compliant T-NEX series
snippet: Daido Japan (大同日本, a TATUNG subsidiary) exhibited at JECA FAIR 2026 (the 74th electrical installation industry fair, May 2026) and announced its T-NEX high-efficiency mold transformer series conforming to Japan's 2026 Top Runner transformer standard, while disclosing it won multiple distribution transformer orders before and after the fair. The company cites rapidly rising demand for high-efficiency equipment ahead of full enforcement of the 2026 Top Runner standard.
src: 時事ドットコム（PR TIMES配信）· 6 Jul 2026 [ja]

title: Hokkaido Electric Power Network (北電ネット) to build new substations in Ishikari and Tomakomai for data-center demand
snippet: Hokkaido Electric Power Network plans to construct new substations in Ishikari and Tomakomai to accommodate rising electricity demand from data centers entering the region. The substation build-out is part of the utility's grid infrastructure response to load growth.
src: 北海道新聞デジタル · 30 Mar 2026 [ja]

title: Grid council (広域機関) sets Chugoku–Kyushu transmission reinforcement plan, targeting March 2039 operation
snippet: The Organization for Cross-regional Coordination of Transmission Operators (電力広域的運営推進機関) formulated a plan to reinforce the Chugoku–Kyushu transmission interconnection (中国九州間連系設備), aiming for operation start in March 2039. The plan was filed with METI in mid-October 2025 as a wide-area grid development plan (広域系統整備計画), underpinning cross-regional grid investment.
src: 中国新聞デジタル · 15 Oct 2025 [ja]

title: TEPCO Power Grid solicits land for 500 kV substations in Tokyo, Ibaraki and Chiba to serve data-center demand
snippet: Tokyo Electric Power Grid (東電PG) began soliciting land for new substations — EHV substations (275–500 kV/154 kV) around Tsukuba, Ibaraki and Kashiwa, Chiba, plus intermediate and distribution substations near central Tokyo stations — as a second solicitation round following December 2024. The company plans to build 2–3 new 500 kV/154 kV substations by 2040, enabling acceptance of 6–9 GW of additional data-center and industrial demand.
value: 500 kV/154 kV · 6–9 GW DC demand by 2040

title: Hitachi to invest over JPY 150bn in US, including new transformer plant for data centers
snippet: Nikkei reports Hitachi is investing more than JPY 150bn in the United States, including a new transformer plant oriented to data-center demand. The move reflects growing US power-equipment demand and transformer supply tightness.

title: LS Electric wins ~KRW 100bn ultra-high-voltage transformer order from US big-tech client
snippet: Yonhap reports LS Electric (LS일렉트릭) secured an ultra-high-voltage (EHV) transformer order worth about KRW 100bn from a major US technology company. The deal extends the Korean equipment maker's exposure to AI-driven US data-center power demand and adds to its transformer backlog. The customer and delivery terms were not disclosed.

title: Iljin Electric wins KRW 120bn EHV transformer order for Canadian data centers
snippet: Iljin Electric (일진전기) announced a transformer supply contract worth about KRW 120bn for Canadian data centers, per Yonhap. The order underscores the trend of Korean power-equipment makers capturing AI/data-center-driven demand in North America.

title: HD Hyundai Electric raises 2026 order target 23% to about KRW 8tn on global grid demand
snippet: HD Hyundai Electric (HD현대일렉트릭) lifted its 2026 order target by about 23% to roughly KRW 8tn, citing strong global demand for power infrastructure tied to AI and electrification, per Donga Bizn. Transformer and switchgear backlogs continue to expand as US and European grid investment rises.

title: KEPCO to build third transmission line and undersea grid link for Incheon Yeongjong after blackouts
snippet: After large-scale blackouts on Incheon's Yeongjong Island, KEPCO (한국전력) is pushing ahead with a third transmission line plus an undersea transmission route, with about KRW 35.4bn to be invested, per Yonhap and Herald Economy coverage. The reinforcement adds redundancy to the island's power supply after repeated outage incidents.

title: Astor Enerji signs TRY 816.2m contract with TEİAŞ after grid tender win
snippet: Turkish transformer maker Astor Enerji signed a TRY 816.2m contract following a TEİAŞ tender award, reported by Enerji Günlüğü and Petroturk in early July 2026. The deal adds to Astor's order book from Türkiye's grid operator amid ongoing network expansion.

title: Hitachi Energy inaugurates USD 70m power transformer factory and service center in Dilovası, Türkiye
snippet: Hitachi Energy opened a new power transformer factory and service center in Dilovası, Kocaeli, backed by a USD 70m investment, per the company's Turkish-language press release. The facility strengthens Türkiye's transformer manufacturing base for domestic supply and exports.

title: TEİAŞ publishes 2,000 MWe of transformer-based unlicensed generation capacity for 2026
snippet: TEİAŞ published its 2026 allocation of a total 2,000 MWe of unlicensed electricity generation capacity to be assigned at distribution level on a transformer basis, announced via GENSED. The scheme ties new distributed-generation connections to available transformer capacity at substations.

title: Egypt's electricity minister: EGP 37bn for developing and upgrading the transmission grid
snippet: Egyptian Electricity Minister Mahmoud Esmat announced EGP 37bn of investments to support, develop and modernize the transmission network and raise its capacity to absorb new renewable generation, per Masrawy. The program targets grid reinforcement as renewables and new capacity connect to the system.

title: GCC–Oman direct electrical interconnection project launches with USD 700m funding
snippet: The direct electrical interconnection project between the GCC grid and Oman was launched with USD 700m in financing, strengthening Gulf energy security and integration, per Asharq Al-Awsat. The link expands cross-border transmission capacity between the GCCIA network and Oman's power system.
